<script>
// Advanced Cyber Canvas - Particle Rain & Energy Effects
const cyberCanvas = document.getElementById('cyber-canvas');
if (cyberCanvas) {
    const ctx = cyberCanvas.getContext('2d');
    let particles = [];
    let energyBursts = [];
    const particleCount = 80;
    let animationId;
    
    function resize() {
        cyberCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        cyberCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    
    function createParticles() {
        particles = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
            particles.push({
                x: Math.random() * cyberCanvas.width,
                y: Math.random() * cyberCanvas.height,
                vy: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
                size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
                alpha: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1,
                trail: []
            });
        }
    }
    
    function addEnergyBurst(x, y) {
        energyBursts.push({
            x, y,
            radius: 0,
            maxRadius: 100 + Math.random() * 50,
            alpha: 0.6
        });
    }
    
    function drawParticles(time) {
        particles.forEach(p => {
            // Update position
            p.y += p.vy;
            p.x += Math.sin(time * 0.001 + p.y * 0.01) * 0.3;
            
            // Reset if off screen
            if (p.y > cyberCanvas.height) {
                p.y = -10;
                p.x = Math.random() * cyberCanvas.width;
            }
            
            // Draw particle with glow
            const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, p.size * 3);
            gradient.addColorStop(0, `rgba(220, 38, 38, ${p.alpha})`);
            gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(220, 38, 38, 0)');
            
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
            ctx.fill();
            
            // Core
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 100, 100, ${p.alpha * 1.5})`;
            ctx.fill();
        });
    }
    
    function drawEnergyBursts() {
        energyBursts = energyBursts.filter(burst => {
            burst.radius += 3;
            burst.alpha -= 0.015;
            
            if (burst.alpha <= 0) return false;
            
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(burst.x, burst.y, burst.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(220, 38, 38, ${burst.alpha})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.stroke();
            
            return true;
        });
    }
    
    function drawConnections() {
        const connectionDistance = 150;
        for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
            for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
                const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
                const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
                const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                
                if (dist < connectionDistance) {
                    const alpha = (1 - dist / connectionDistance) * 0.1;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                    ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(220, 38, 38, ${alpha})`;
                    ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    function animate(time) {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cyberCanvas.width, cyberCanvas.height);
        
        drawConnections();
        drawParticles(time);
        drawEnergyBursts();
        
        // Random energy bursts
        if (Math.random() > 0.995) {
            addEnergyBurst(
                Math.random() * cyberCanvas.width,
                Math.random() * cyberCanvas.height
            );
        }
        
        animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    
    resize();
    createParticles();
    animate(0);
    
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        resize();
        createParticles();
    });
    
    // Pause when not visible
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (document.hidden) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
        } else {
            animate(0);
        }
    });
}

let currentProduct = null;
let selectedVariant = null;

function openProductFromBtn(btn) {
    try {
        var productData = btn.getAttribute('data-product');
        console.log('Raw product data:', productData);
        var product = JSON.parse(productData);
        openProductModal(product);
    } catch(e) {
        console.error('Error parsing product:', e);
        alert('Unable to load product details. Please refresh the page.');
    }
}

function openProductModal(product) {
    currentProduct = product;
    
    const modal = document.getElementById('productModal');
    const modalImage = document.getElementById('modalImage');
    const modalName = document.getElementById('modalName');
    const modalPrice = document.getElementById('modalPrice');
    const modalDescription = document.getElementById('modalDescription');
    const variantSelector = document.getElementById('variantSelector');
    const variantOptions = document.getElementById('variantOptions');
    
    modalImage.src = product.main_image || product.thumbnail || '/static/images/book-placeholder.svg';
    modalImage.onerror = function() { this.src = '/static/images/book-placeholder.svg'; };
    modalName.textContent = product.name;
    modalDescription.textContent = product.description || 'Premium Protocol Pulse merchandise. Built for Bitcoin believers.';
    
    if (product.variants && product.variants.length > 0) {
        selectedVariant = product.variants[0];
        modalPrice.textContent = `$${selectedVariant.price} ${selectedVariant.currency}`;
        
        if (product.variants.length > 1) {
            variantSelector.style.display = 'block';
            variantOptions.innerHTML = '';
            
            product.variants.forEach((variant, index) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'variant-btn' + (index === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                btn.textContent = variant.size || variant.name || `Option ${index + 1}`;
                btn.onclick = function() {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.variant-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                    this.classList.add('active');
                    selectedVariant = variant;
                    modalPrice.textContent = `$${variant.price} ${variant.currency}`;
                };
                variantOptions.appendChild(btn);
            });
        } else {
            variantSelector.style.display = 'none';
        }
    } else {
        modalPrice.textContent = 'Price TBD';
        variantSelector.style.display = 'none';
    }
    
    modal.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function closeProductModal() {
    document.getElementById('productModal').classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    currentProduct = null;
    selectedVariant = null;
}

function purchaseProduct() {
    console.log('Purchase clicked', currentProduct, selectedVariant);
    
    if (!currentProduct) {
        alert('No product selected');
        return;
    }
    
    if (!selectedVariant && currentProduct.variants && currentProduct.variants.length > 0) {
        selectedVariant = currentProduct.variants[0];
    }
    
    if (!selectedVariant) {
        alert('Please select a size/variant');
        return;
    }
    
    const purchaseBtn = document.getElementById('purchaseBtn');
    purchaseBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Processing...';
    purchaseBtn.disabled = true;
    
    const checkoutData = {
        items: [{
            variant_id: selectedVariant.id || selectedVariant.variant_id,
            quantity: 1,
            name: currentProduct.name,
            price: parseFloat(selectedVariant.price || selectedVariant.retail_price || 29.99),
            size: selectedVariant.size || selectedVariant.name || 'One Size'
        }]
    };
    
    console.log('Checkout data:', checkoutData);
    
    fetch('/api/merch/checkout', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(checkoutData)
    })
    .then(response => {
        console.log('Response status:', response.status);
        return response.json();
    })
    .then(data => {
        console.log('Checkout response:', data);
        if (data.success && data.checkout_url) {
            // Open Stripe in a new window to avoid iframe restrictions
            var stripeWindow = window.open(data.checkout_url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
            if (!stripeWindow) {
                // Fallback if popup blocked
                window.location.href = data.checkout_url;
            }
            closeProductModal();
            purchaseBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-shopping-cart"></i> Buy Now';
            purchaseBtn.disabled = false;
        } else {
            throw new Error(data.error || 'Checkout failed');
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('Checkout error:', error);
        alert('Unable to process checkout: ' + error.message);
        purchaseBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-shopping-cart"></i> Buy Now';
        purchaseBtn.disabled = false;
    });
}

document.getElementById('productModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) {
        closeProductModal();
    }
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeProductModal();
    }
});

// RTSA content is now server-rendered (no client-side fetch needed)
</script>

<script>
// Signal Terminal JavaScript
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const feedItems = document.querySelectorAll('.signal-card');
    const inspectorEmpty = document.getElementById('inspectorEmpty');
    const inspectorContent = document.getElementById('inspectorContent');
    const zapModalOverlay = document.getElementById('zapModalOverlay');
    let currentPost = null;
    let selectedAmount = 100;
    
    // Feed item selection
    feedItems.forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', function() {
            feedItems.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
            this.classList.add('active');
            
            const postId = this.dataset.postId;
            loadInspector(postId);
        });
    });
    
    function loadInspector(postId) {
        inspectorEmpty.style.display = 'none';
        inspectorContent.style.display = 'block';
        
        // Fetch post details via API
        fetch(`/api/value-stream/post/${postId}`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if (data.success) {
                    updateInspector(data.post);
                    currentPost = data.post;
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error('Error loading post:', err);
            });
    }
    
    function updateInspector(post) {
        document.getElementById('inspectorTitle').textContent = post.title || 'Untitled Signal';
        document.getElementById('inspectorPlatform').textContent = post.platform;
        document.getElementById('inspectorCurator').textContent = post.curator_name || 'Anonymous';
        document.getElementById('inspectorAge').textContent = post.age_display || 'Just now';
        document.getElementById('econTotalSats').textContent = (post.total_sats || 0).toLocaleString();
        document.getElementById('econZapCount').textContent = post.zap_count || 0;
        document.getElementById('econBoosts').textContent = (post.boost_sats || 0).toLocaleString();
        
        // Update embed if YouTube
        const embedContainer = document.getElementById('embedContainer');
        if (post.platform === 'youtube' && post.original_id) {
            embedContainer.innerHTML = `<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/${post.original_id}" allowfullscreen></iframe>`;
        } else {
            embedContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="embed-placeholder"><a href="${post.original_url}" target="_blank" style="color: var(--signal-orange);"><i class="fas fa-external-link-alt fa-3x"></i><p style="margin-top: 16px;">View on ${post.platform}</p></a></div>`;
        }
    }
    
    // Zap Modal
    document.getElementById('openZapModal').addEventListener('click', () => {
        zapModalOverlay.classList.add('active');
    });
    
    document.getElementById('closeZapModal').addEventListener('click', () => {
        zapModalOverlay.classList.remove('active');
    });
    
    zapModalOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === zapModalOverlay) {
            zapModalOverlay.classList.remove('active');
        }
    });
    
    // Zap presets
    document.querySelectorAll('.zap-preset').forEach(preset => {
        preset.addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.zap-preset').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            this.classList.add('active');
            selectedAmount = parseInt(this.dataset.amount);
            updateSplitPreview(selectedAmount);
        });
    });
    
    document.getElementById('zapCustomAmount').addEventListener('input', function() {
        const amount = parseInt(this.value) || 0;
        selectedAmount = amount;
        document.querySelectorAll('.zap-preset').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        updateSplitPreview(amount);
    });
    
    function updateSplitPreview(amount) {
        document.getElementById('splitCreator').textContent = Math.floor(amount * 0.85).toLocaleString() + ' sats';
        document.getElementById('splitCurator').textContent = Math.floor(amount * 0.10).toLocaleString() + ' sats';
        document.getElementById('splitPlatform').textContent = Math.floor(amount * 0.05).toLocaleString() + ' sats';
    }
    
    // WebLN Detection
    if (typeof window.webln !== 'undefined') {
        document.getElementById('walletStatus').innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> Wallet detected';
        document.getElementById('walletStatus').classList.remove('disconnected');
        document.getElementById('walletStatus').classList.add('connected');
    }
    
    // Confirm Zap
    document.getElementById('confirmZap').addEventListener('click', async function() {
        if (!currentPost) return;
        
        this.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Processing...';
        this.disabled = true;
        
        try {
            // Request invoice from backend
            const invoiceRes = await fetch('/api/value-stream/invoice', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    post_id: currentPost.id,
                    amount: selectedAmount
                })
            });
            
            const invoiceData = await invoiceRes.json();
            
            if (invoiceData.success && window.webln) {
                await window.webln.enable();
                await window.webln.sendPayment(invoiceData.invoice);
                
                zapModalOverlay.classList.remove('active');
                showToast('Zap sent successfully!', 'success');
                
                // Update UI
                const satsEl = document.getElementById('econTotalSats');
                satsEl.textContent = (parseInt(satsEl.textContent.replace(/,/g, '')) + selectedAmount).toLocaleString();
            } else if (!window.webln) {
                showToast('Please install a WebLN wallet (Alby, Zeus, etc.)', 'warning');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Zap error:', err);
            showToast('Zap failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
        }
        
        this.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> CONFIRM ZAP';
        this.disabled = false;
    });
    
    function showToast(message, type) {
        const toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; padding: 16px 24px;
            background: ${type === 'success' ? 'var(--signal-green)' : type === 'error' ? 'var(--signal-red)' : 'var(--signal-orange)'};
            color: #000; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; z-index: 2000;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s ease;
        `;
        toast.textContent = message;
        document.body.appendChild(toast);
        setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 3000);
    }
    
    // Command bar handling
    document.getElementById('commandInput').addEventListener('keypress', async function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            const value = this.value.trim();
            
            if (value.startsWith('http')) {
                // Submit URL
                const res = await fetch('/api/value-stream/submit', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ url: value })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    showToast('Content curated!', 'success');
                    this.value = '';
                    location.reload();
                } else {
                    showToast(data.error || 'Failed to curate', 'error');
                }
            } else if (value.includes(':')) {
                // Filter command
                applyFilters(value);
            }
        }
    });
    
    function applyFilters(query) {
        // Parse filter commands like "platform:youtube last:24h"
        console.log('Applying filters:', query);
        // TODO: Implement filter logic
    }
    
    // Mode toggle
    document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            this.classList.add('active');
            
            const mode = this.dataset.mode;
            document.body.dataset.displayMode = mode;
        });
    });
    
    // Filter chips
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach(chip => {
        chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
            this.classList.add('active');
            
            const sort = this.dataset.sort;
            // TODO: Re-sort feed based on selection
            console.log('Sorting by:', sort);
        });
    });
    
    // Auto-select first item if exists
    if (feedItems.length > 0) {
        feedItems[0].click();
    }
    
    // Real-time SSE connection with browser compatibility check
    let eventSource = null;
    
    function connectSSE() {
        if (typeof EventSource === 'undefined') {
            console.warn('SSE not supported in this browser');
            return;
        }
        
        eventSource = new EventSource('/api/signal-terminal/stream');
        
        eventSource.onmessage = function(event) {
            const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
            
            if (data.type === 'reconnect') {
                console.log('Server requested reconnect:', data.reason);
                eventSource.close();
                setTimeout(connectSSE, 1000);
                return;
            }
            
            if (data.type === 'error') {
                console.error('SSE error:', data.message);
                return;
            }
            
            if (data.type === 'new_post') {
                const feedContainer = document.getElementById('feedItems');
                if (!feedContainer) return;
                
                const newCard = document.createElement('div');
                newCard.className = 'signal-card hot';
                newCard.dataset.postId = data.id;
                newCard.dataset.signalScore = data.signal_score || 0;
                newCard.dataset.velocity = data.velocity || 0;
                newCard.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="signal-meta">
                        <span class="platform-icon ${data.platform}">
                            <i class="fab fa-${data.platform === 'twitter' ? 'twitter' : data.platform === 'youtube' ? 'youtube' : 'globe'}"></i>
                        </span>
                        <span class="signal-age">just now</span>
                        <span class="velocity-badge ${data.velocity > 5 ? 'high' : ''}">
                            <i class="fas fa-arrow-up"></i> ${data.velocity}/h
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="signal-title">${data.title}</div>
                    <div class="signal-stats">
                        <span class="stat-item sats"><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> ${data.total_sats.toLocaleString()}</span>
                        <span class="stat-item zaps">${data.zap_count} zaps</span>
                        <div class="cooling-meter"><div class="cooling-fill" style="width: 100%"></div></div>
                    </div>
                `;
                newCard.style.animation = 'slideIn 0.3s ease';
                
                // Insert based on signal score for proper ranking
                insertCardByScore(feedContainer, newCard, data.signal_score || 0);
                
                newCard.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.signal-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
                    this.classList.add('active');
                    loadInspector(data.id);
                });
                
                showToast(`New signal: ${data.title.substring(0, 30)}...`, 'success');
            }
            
            if (data.type === 'new_zap') {
                const card = document.querySelector(`.signal-card[data-post-id="${data.post_id}"]`);
                if (card) {
                    const satsEl = card.querySelector('.stat-item.sats');
                    if (satsEl) {
                        const currentSats = parseInt(satsEl.textContent.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')) || 0;
                        satsEl.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> ${(currentSats + data.amount).toLocaleString()}`;
                        satsEl.style.animation = 'pulse 0.5s ease';
                    }
                }
                
                const tickerEl = document.getElementById('satsFlowValue');
                if (tickerEl) {
                    const currentFlow = parseInt(tickerEl.textContent.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')) || 0;
                    tickerEl.textContent = (currentFlow + data.amount).toLocaleString();
                }
            }
        };
        
        eventSource.onerror = function() {
            console.log('SSE connection lost, reconnecting in 5s...');
            eventSource.close();
            setTimeout(connectSSE, 5000);
        };
    }
    
    function insertCardByScore(container, newCard, score) {
        const cards = container.querySelectorAll('.signal-card');
        let inserted = false;
        
        for (let card of cards) {
            const cardScore = parseFloat(card.dataset.signalScore) || 0;
            if (score > cardScore) {
                container.insertBefore(newCard, card);
                inserted = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if (!inserted) {
            container.appendChild(newCard);
        }
    }
    
    // Start SSE connection
    connectSSE();
    
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() {
        if (eventSource) eventSource.close();
    });
});

// CSS animation for new items
const style = document.createElement('style');
style.textContent = `
    @keyframes slideIn {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-20px); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
`;
document.head.appendChild(style);
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // ===== APEX v3.0: DIEGETIC AUDIO FEEDBACK =====
    const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    
    function playRelayClick() {
        if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
        
        const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
        const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
        
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
        
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(800, audioCtx.currentTime);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(200, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
        
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
        
        osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
        osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
    }
    
    // ===== APEX v3.0: MEMPOOL PARTICLE STREAM (DATA-DRIVEN) =====
    const mempoolCanvas = document.getElementById('mempoolCanvas');
    if (mempoolCanvas) {
        const ctx = mempoolCanvas.getContext('2d');
        const particles = [];
        let currentFeeRate = 12; // Updated from network data
        let whaleThresholdBTC = 500;
        
        function resizeMempoolCanvas() {
            const strip = mempoolCanvas.parentElement;
            mempoolCanvas.width = strip.offsetWidth;
            mempoolCanvas.height = strip.offsetHeight;
        }
        resizeMempoolCanvas();
        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeMempoolCanvas);
        
        // Fetch real fee rate from network
        async function updateFeeRate() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/network-stats');
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data.fee_rate) {
                        currentFeeRate = parseInt(data.fee_rate) || 12;
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) { /* Use default */ }
        }
        updateFeeRate();
        setInterval(updateFeeRate, 30000);
        
        class Particle {
            constructor(isWhale = false, btcValue = 0) {
                this.x = Math.random() * mempoolCanvas.width;
                this.y = -10;
                this.size = isWhale ? Math.min(8, 3 + btcValue / 200) : Math.random() * 2 + 1;
                // Speed tied to current fee rate from network
                this.speed = (currentFeeRate / 15) * (Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5);
                this.isWhale = isWhale;
                this.btcValue = btcValue;
                this.opacity = isWhale ? 1 : Math.random() * 0.6 + 0.2;
            }
            
            update() {
                this.y += this.speed;
                if (this.y > mempoolCanvas.height + 10) return false;
                return true;
            }
            
            draw() {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                if (this.isWhale) {
                    // White-hot flash for whale moves (>500 BTC)
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${this.opacity})`;
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
                    ctx.shadowColor = '#ffffff';
                } else {
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(220, 38, 38, ${this.opacity})`;
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                }
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            }
        }
        
        // Simulate transaction stream (in production, connect to mempool.space WebSocket)
        function simulateTransaction() {
            // Simulate realistic BTC transaction distribution
            const btcValue = Math.random() < 0.005 ? 
                whaleThresholdBTC + Math.random() * 1000 : // 0.5% chance of whale (>500 BTC)
                Math.random() * 10; // Normal transactions
            
            const isWhale = btcValue >= whaleThresholdBTC;
            particles.push(new Particle(isWhale, btcValue));
            
            if (isWhale) {
                // Whale alert flash
                mempoolCanvas.parentElement.classList.add('whale-flash');
                setTimeout(() => mempoolCanvas.parentElement.classList.remove('whale-flash'), 500);
                console.log(`[WHALE ALERT] ${btcValue.toFixed(2)} BTC transaction detected`);
            }
        }
        
        function animateMempool() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, mempoolCanvas.width, mempoolCanvas.height);
            
            // Add new particles based on network activity
            if (Math.random() < 0.25) {
                simulateTransaction();
            }
            
            // Update and draw particles
            for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (!particles[i].update()) {
                    particles.splice(i, 1);
                } else {
                    particles[i].draw();
                }
            }
            
            requestAnimationFrame(animateMempool);
        }
        animateMempool();
    }
    
    // ===== APEX v3.0: HOLOGRAPHIC SENTIMENT NEEDLE (CSS TRANSITION) =====
    const dialNeedle = document.getElementById('dialNeedle');
    const dialStateText = document.getElementById('dialStateText');
    let targetSentiment = 65;
    
    function updateSentimentNeedle(sentiment) {
        if (!dialNeedle) return;
        
        // Calculate needle rotation (-90 to 90 degrees)
        const rotation = (sentiment / 100) * 180 - 90;
        
        // Apply rotation with CSS transition (weighted inertia via cubic-bezier)
        dialNeedle.style.transform = `rotate(${rotation}deg)`;
        
        // Update state text
        if (sentiment < 35) dialStateText.textContent = 'FEAR';
        else if (sentiment < 50) dialStateText.textContent = 'CAUTION';
        else if (sentiment < 65) dialStateText.textContent = 'EQUILIBRIUM';
        else if (sentiment < 80) dialStateText.textContent = 'OPTIMISM';
        else dialStateText.textContent = 'EUPHORIA';
    }
    
    // Initialize
    updateSentimentNeedle(targetSentiment);
    
    // Update sentiment from API or simulate realistic changes
    async function fetchSentiment() {
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/network-stats');
            if (res.ok) {
                const data = await res.json();
                // Derive sentiment from network conditions
                if (data.fee_rate) {
                    const fee = parseInt(data.fee_rate) || 12;
                    // Low fees = optimism, high fees = caution
                    targetSentiment = Math.max(20, Math.min(85, 70 - fee * 0.5 + Math.random() * 10));
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            // Simulate sentiment drift
            targetSentiment = Math.max(25, Math.min(80, targetSentiment + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8));
        }
        updateSentimentNeedle(targetSentiment);
    }
    
    fetchSentiment();
    setInterval(fetchSentiment, 5000);

    document.querySelectorAll('.series-card-holo').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
            // Ambient shift handled above
        });
    });
    
    // Episode card click - wire to audio player with diegetic feedback
    document.querySelectorAll('.episode-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', function() {
            playRelayClick(); // Diegetic audio feedback
            
            const audioBar = document.getElementById('audioBar');
            const audioTitle = document.getElementById('audioTitle');
            const podcastAudio = document.getElementById('podcastAudio');
            
            audioBar.style.display = 'flex';
            audioTitle.textContent = this.querySelector('.episode-title').textContent;
            
            // Update tactical briefing based on episode
            const briefingText = document.getElementById('briefingText');
            if (briefingText) {
                const episodeTitle = this.querySelector('.episode-title').textContent;
                const contextBadges = this.querySelectorAll('.context-badge');
                let topics = [];
                contextBadges.forEach(b => topics.push(b.textContent));
                
                const briefings = [
                    `High-signal content detected. ${topics.length ? topics.join(' + ') + ' analysis' : 'Deep-dive intel'} for sovereign operators.`,
                    `This asset contains actionable intelligence on ${topics[0] || 'Bitcoin'} dynamics. Attention recommended.`,
                    `Network data suggests this content correlates with macro shifts. Briefing priority: HIGH.`

            }

            const audioUrl = this.dataset.audioUrl;
            if (audioUrl && podcastAudio) {
                podcastAudio.src = audioUrl;
                podcastAudio.load();

                initAudioContext();

                document.getElementById('currentTime').textContent = '0:00';
            }

    });
    
    // Fetch live network data
    async function updateTelemetry() {
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/network-stats');
            if (res.ok) {
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.mempool_size) document.getElementById('mempoolSize').textContent = data.mempool_size;
                if (data.pending_txs) document.getElementById('pendingTxs').textContent = data.pending_txs.toLocaleString();
                if (data.fee_rate) document.getElementById('feeRate').textContent = data.fee_rate + ' sat/vB';
                if (data.hashrate) document.getElementById('hashrate').textContent = data.hashrate;
            }
        } catch (e) {

        }
    }
    
    // Update every 60 seconds
    updateTelemetry();
    setInterval(updateTelemetry, 60000);
    
    // ===== LIVE TWEETS SYSTEM =====
    const tweetsContainer = document.getElementById('liveTweetsContainer');
    const connectionStatus = document.getElementById('tweetConnectionStatus');
    let previousTweetIds = new Set();
    
    function formatNumber(num) {
        if (num >= 1000) return (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k';
        return num.toString();
    }
    
    function renderTweet(tweet, isNew = false) {
        const tweetData = JSON.stringify(tweet).replace(/'/g, "\\'").replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
        return `
            <div class="tweet-card ${isNew ? 'new-tweet' : ''}" 
                 onclick="openSignalModal('tweet', ${tweetData})" 
                 title="Click to expand">
                <div class="tweet-header">
                    <div class="tweet-avatar">${tweet.avatar || '🟠'}</div>
                    <div class="tweet-author">
                        <div class="tweet-name">
                            ${tweet.name}
                            ${tweet.verified ? '<i class="fas fa-check-circle tweet-verified"></i>' : ''}
                        </div>
                        <div class="tweet-handle">${tweet.handle}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tweet-time">${tweet.time_ago}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="tweet-text">${tweet.text}</div>
                <div class="tweet-metrics">
                    <span class="tweet-metric"><i class="far fa-heart"></i> ${formatNumber(tweet.metrics?.likes || 0)}</span>
                    <span class="tweet-metric"><i class="fas fa-retweet"></i> ${formatNumber(tweet.metrics?.retweets || 0)}</span>
                    <span class="tweet-metric"><i class="far fa-comment"></i> ${formatNumber(tweet.metrics?.replies || 0)}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }
    
    async function fetchLiveTweets() {
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/live-tweets');
            if (res.ok) {
                const data = await res.json();
                
                if (data.success && data.tweets.length > 0) {
                    // Update connection status based on API response
                    const statusText = data.is_demo ? 'DEMO' : 'LIVE';
                    connectionStatus.innerHTML = '<span class="live-dot"></span> ' + statusText;
                    connectionStatus.classList.remove('offline');
                    if (data.is_demo) {
                        connectionStatus.classList.add('demo');
                    } else {
                        connectionStatus.classList.remove('demo');
                    }
                    
                    // Render tweets
                    let html = `
                        <div class="tweets-refresh-bar">
                            <span class="tweets-count">${data.tweets.length} SOVEREIGN${data.tweets.length !== 1 ? 'S' : ''}</span>
                            <span>Auto-refresh 30s</span>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    
                    data.tweets.forEach(tweet => {
                        const isNew = !previousTweetIds.has(tweet.id);
                        html += renderTweet(tweet, isNew && previousTweetIds.size > 0);
                    });
                    
                    tweetsContainer.innerHTML = html;
                    
                    // Update previous IDs
                    previousTweetIds = new Set(data.tweets.map(t => t.id));
                } else {
                    throw new Error('No tweets');
                }
            } else {
                throw new Error('API error');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('Tweet fetch error:', e);
            connectionStatus.innerHTML = '<span class="live-dot"></span> OFFLINE';
            connectionStatus.classList.add('offline');
            
            // Show error state
            tweetsContainer.innerHTML = `
                <div class="tweet-loading">
                    <i class="fab fa-twitter" style="font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--text-muted);"></i>
                    <span>Feed temporarily unavailable</span>
                </div>
            `;
        }
    }
    
    // Initial fetch + auto-refresh every 30 seconds
    fetchLiveTweets();
    setInterval(fetchLiveTweets, 30000);
    
    // ===== APEX v3.0: OSCILLOSCOPE WAVEFORM VISUALIZER =====
    let audioContext = null;
    let analyser = null;
    let audioSource = null;
    let oscilloscopeAnimId = null;
    const audioElement = document.getElementById('podcastAudio');
    const oscilloscopeCanvas = document.getElementById('oscilloscopeCanvas');
    const oscCtx = oscilloscopeCanvas ? oscilloscopeCanvas.getContext('2d') : null;
    
    function initAudioContext() {
        if (!audioContext && audioElement) {
            audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
            analyser.fftSize = 2048;
            analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.85;
            
            audioSource = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioElement);
            audioSource.connect(analyser);
            analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        }
    }
    
    function resizeOscilloscope() {
        if (oscilloscopeCanvas) {
            const container = oscilloscopeCanvas.parentElement;
            oscilloscopeCanvas.width = container.offsetWidth;
            oscilloscopeCanvas.height = container.offsetHeight;
        }
    }
    resizeOscilloscope();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeOscilloscope);
    
    function drawOscilloscope() {
        if (!oscilloscopeCanvas || !oscCtx) return;
        
        const width = oscilloscopeCanvas.width;
        const height = oscilloscopeCanvas.height;
        
        oscCtx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
        
        // Draw waveform
        oscCtx.beginPath();
        oscCtx.strokeStyle = '#dc2626';
        oscCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        oscCtx.shadowBlur = 8;
        oscCtx.shadowColor = '#dc2626';
        
        if (analyser) {
            const dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize);
            analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
            
            const sliceWidth = width / dataArray.length;
            let x = 0;
            
            for (let i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++) {
                const v = dataArray[i] / 128.0;
                const y = (v * height) / 2;
                
                if (i === 0) {
                    oscCtx.moveTo(x, y);
                } else {
                    oscCtx.lineTo(x, y);
                }
                x += sliceWidth;
            }
        } else {
            // Demo waveform when no audio
            const time = Date.now() / 1000;
            for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                const y = height / 2 + Math.sin(x * 0.05 + time * 3) * (height / 4) * Math.sin(time * 0.5);
                if (x === 0) oscCtx.moveTo(x, y);
                else oscCtx.lineTo(x, y);
            }
        }
        
        oscCtx.stroke();
        oscCtx.shadowBlur = 0;
        
        // Draw center line
        oscCtx.beginPath();
        oscCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2)';
        oscCtx.lineWidth = 1;
        oscCtx.moveTo(0, height / 2);
        oscCtx.lineTo(width, height / 2);
        oscCtx.stroke();
        
        oscilloscopeAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(drawOscilloscope);
    }
    
    function stopOscilloscope() {
        if (oscilloscopeAnimId) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(oscilloscopeAnimId);
            oscilloscopeAnimId = null;
        }
        if (oscCtx && oscilloscopeCanvas) {
            oscCtx.clearRect(0, 0, oscilloscopeCanvas.width, oscilloscopeCanvas.height);
        }
    }
    
    // Start visualizer when audio plays
    const playBtn = document.getElementById('playPauseBtn');
    let isPlaying = false;
    
    playBtn?.addEventListener('click', function() {
        playRelayClick(); // Diegetic feedback
        isPlaying = !isPlaying;
        this.innerHTML = isPlaying ? '<i class="fas fa-pause"></i>' : '<i class="fas fa-play"></i>';
        
        if (audioElement && audioElement.src) {
            initAudioContext();
            if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') {
                audioContext.resume();
            }
            if (isPlaying) {
                audioElement.play();
                drawOscilloscope();
            } else {
                audioElement.pause();
                stopOscilloscope();
            }
        } else {
            // Demo mode: show animated oscilloscope without audio
            if (isPlaying) {
                drawOscilloscope();
            } else {
                stopOscilloscope();
            }
        }
    });
    
    // Update progress bar from audio element
    if (audioElement) {
        audioElement.addEventListener('timeupdate', function() {
            const progress = (audioElement.currentTime / audioElement.duration) * 100;
            document.getElementById('progressFill').style.width = progress + '%';
            document.getElementById('currentTime').textContent = formatTime(audioElement.currentTime);
        });
        
        audioElement.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function() {
            document.getElementById('totalTime').textContent = formatTime(audioElement.duration);
        });
        
        audioElement.addEventListener('ended', function() {
            isPlaying = false;
            playBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-play"></i>';
            stopVisualizer();
        });
    }
    
    function formatTime(seconds) {
        const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
        const s = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
        return m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
    }
});

}

// ===== SIGNAL CONTENT MODAL SYSTEM =====
const signalModalOverlay = document.getElementById('signalModalOverlay');
const modalSourceIcon = document.getElementById('modalSourceIcon');
const modalSourceName = document.getElementById('modalSourceName');
const modalContent = document.getElementById('modalContent');
const modalExternalLink = document.getElementById('modalExternalLink');
const modalClose = document.getElementById('modalClose');

function openSignalModal(type, data) {
    let iconClass = 'twitter';
    let iconHtml = '<i class="fab fa-twitter"></i>';
    let sourceName = 'SOVEREIGN BROADCAST';
    let contentHtml = '';
    let externalUrl = '#';
    
    if (type === 'tweet') {
        iconClass = 'twitter';
        iconHtml = '<i class="fab fa-x-twitter"></i>';
        sourceName = 'SOVEREIGN BROADCAST';
        externalUrl = data.url || `https://x.com/${(data.handle || '').replace('@', '')}`;
        
        contentHtml = `
            <div class="modal-tweet-card">
                <div class="modal-tweet-header">
                    <div class="modal-tweet-avatar">${data.avatar || '🟠'}</div>
                    <div class="modal-tweet-author">
                        <div class="modal-tweet-name">
                            ${data.name || 'Sovereign'}
                            ${data.verified ? '<i class="fas fa-check-circle tweet-verified"></i>' : ''}
                        </div>
                        <div class="modal-tweet-handle">${data.handle || ''}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="modal-tweet-time">${data.time_ago || ''}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-tweet-text">${data.text || ''}</div>
                <div class="modal-tweet-metrics">
                    <span class="modal-metric"><i class="far fa-heart"></i> ${data.metrics?.likes || 0}</span>
                    <span class="modal-metric"><i class="fas fa-retweet"></i> ${data.metrics?.retweets || 0}</span>
                    <span class="modal-metric"><i class="far fa-comment"></i> ${data.metrics?.replies || 0}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    } else if (type === 'intel') {
        iconClass = 'intel';
        iconHtml = '<i class="fas fa-satellite-dish"></i>';
        sourceName = 'INTEL STREAM';
        externalUrl = data.x_url || '#';
        
        const personaClass = (data.persona || 'alex').toLowerCase();
        contentHtml = `
            <div class="modal-intel-card">
                <div class="modal-intel-header">
                    <span class="modal-intel-persona ${personaClass}">
                        <i class="fas ${personaClass === 'sarah' ? 'fa-globe' : 'fa-chart-line'}"></i>
                        ${(data.persona || 'Alex').toUpperCase()}
                    </span>
                    <span class="modal-tweet-time">${data.time_ago || ''}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-intel-text">${data.primary_tweet || data.content || ''}</div>
                ${data.partner_handle ? `<div class="modal-intel-partner">Reacting to ${data.partner_handle}</div>` : ''}
            </div>
        `;
    } else if (type === 'value-stream') {
        iconClass = 'value-stream';
        iconHtml = '<i class="fas fa-signal"></i>';
        sourceName = 'VALUE STREAM';
        externalUrl = data.url || '#';
        
        contentHtml = `
            <div class="modal-intel-card">
                <div class="modal-intel-header">
                    <span class="modal-intel-persona alex">${data.platform || 'NOSTR'}</span>
                    <span class="modal-tweet-time">${data.time_ago || ''}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-intel-text">${data.title || data.content || ''}</div>
            </div>
        `;
    }
    
    modalSourceIcon.className = 'source-icon ' + iconClass;
    modalSourceIcon.innerHTML = iconHtml;
    modalSourceName.textContent = sourceName;
    modalContent.innerHTML = contentHtml;
    modalExternalLink.href = externalUrl;
    
    if (externalUrl === '#') {
        modalExternalLink.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        modalExternalLink.style.display = 'flex';
    }
    
    signalModalOverlay.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function closeSignalModal() {
    signalModalOverlay.classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

// Close modal on overlay click
if (signalModalOverlay) {
    signalModalOverlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === signalModalOverlay) {
            closeSignalModal();
        }
    });
}

// Close modal on button click
if (modalClose) {
    modalClose.addEventListener('click', closeSignalModal);
}

// Close modal on Escape key
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && signalModalOverlay.classList.contains('active')) {
        closeSignalModal();
    }
});

{% block scripts %}
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.4.1/dist/leaflet.markercluster.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.4.1/dist/MarkerCluster.css" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.4.1/dist/MarkerCluster.Default.css" />
<script>
const meetups = {{ meetups | tojson | safe }};
let markers = [];
let markerCluster;
let currentFilter = null;

const map = L.map('bitcoin-map').setView([25, 0], 2);

L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
    attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://carto.com/">CartoDB</a>',
    maxZoom: 19
}).addTo(map);

const btcIcon = L.divIcon({
    className: 'btc-marker-wrapper',
    html: '<div class="btc-marker">₿</div>',
    iconSize: [30, 30],
    iconAnchor: [15, 15],
    popupAnchor: [0, -15]
});

const eventIcon = L.divIcon({
    className: 'event-marker-wrapper',
    html: '<div class="event-marker" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b5cf6, #6d28d9); border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.6);">⭐</div>',
    iconSize: [32, 32],
    iconAnchor: [16, 16],
    popupAnchor: [0, -16]
});

function initMarkers(filterRegion = null) {
    if (markerCluster) {
        map.removeLayer(markerCluster);
    }
    markers = [];
    markerCluster = L.markerClusterGroup({
        maxClusterRadius: 50,
        spiderfyOnMaxZoom: true,
        showCoverageOnHover: false,
        iconCreateFunction: function(cluster) {
            const count = cluster.getChildCount();
            return L.divIcon({
                html: `<div class="cluster-marker">${count}</div>`,
                className: 'btc-cluster',
                iconSize: [40, 40]
            });
        }
    });
    
    const filteredMeetups = filterRegion 
        ? meetups.filter(m => m.region === filterRegion)
        : meetups;
    
    filteredMeetups.forEach(meetup => {
        const isEvent = meetup.event_type === 'Conference' || meetup.event_type === 'Event';
        const popup = `
            <div class="popup-content" ${isEvent ? 'style="border-color: #8b5cf6;"' : ''}>
                <div class="popup-title" ${isEvent ? 'style="color: #8b5cf6;"' : ''}>${meetup.name}</div>
                ${isEvent ? '<div style="color: #8b5cf6; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 8px;">⭐ Special Event</div>' : ''}
                <div class="popup-info">
                    <strong>Location:</strong> ${meetup.city}<br>
                    ${meetup.venue ? `<strong>Venue:</strong> ${meetup.venue}<br>` : ''}
                    <strong>Region:</strong> ${meetup.region || 'Unknown'}<br>
                    <strong>${isEvent ? 'Date' : 'Schedule'}:</strong> ${meetup.next_event || meetup.frequency}<br>
                    <strong>${isEvent ? 'Expected Attendees' : 'Members'}:</strong> ${meetup.members ? meetup.members.toLocaleString() : 'Unknown'}
                </div>
                ${meetup.url ? `<a href="${meetup.url}" target="_blank" class="popup-link" ${isEvent ? 'style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b5cf6, #6d28d9);"' : ''}>${isEvent ? 'Visit Event Site' : 'Join Meetup'}</a>` : ''}
            </div>
        `;
        
        const markerIcon = isEvent ? eventIcon : btcIcon;
        const marker = L.marker([meetup.lat, meetup.lon], { icon: markerIcon })
            .bindPopup(popup);
        markers.push({ marker, meetup });
        markerCluster.addLayer(marker);
    });
    
    map.addLayer(markerCluster);
    updateMeetupList(filterRegion);
}

function updateMeetupList(filterRegion = null) {
    const listEl = document.getElementById('meetup-list');
    const filteredMeetups = filterRegion 
        ? meetups.filter(m => m.region === filterRegion)
        : meetups;
    
    const sortedMeetups = [...filteredMeetups].sort((a, b) => (b.members || 0) - (a.members || 0));
    
    listEl.innerHTML = sortedMeetups.slice(0, 20).map(meetup => `
        <div class="meetup-card" onclick="flyToMeetup(${meetup.lat}, ${meetup.lon}, '${meetup.name.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">
            <div class="meetup-name">${meetup.name}</div>
            <div class="meetup-city">${meetup.city}</div>
            <div class="meetup-meta">
                <span class="meta-item">
                    <i class="fas fa-calendar"></i> ${meetup.frequency}
                </span>
                <span class="meta-item">
                    <i class="fas fa-users"></i> ${meetup.members ? meetup.members.toLocaleString() : 0}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div class="meetup-region">${meetup.region || ''}</div>
        </div>
    `).join('');
}

function filterRegion(region, btn) {
    currentFilter = region;
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.region-btn').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active');
    });
    if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
    
    initMarkers(region);
    
    if (region) {
        const regionCenters = {
            'North America': [40, -100],
            'Latin America': [-15, -60],
            'Europe': [50, 10],
            'Asia': [30, 105],
            'Africa': [0, 20],
            'Oceania': [-25, 140],
            'Middle East': [28, 45]
        };
        const center = regionCenters[region] || [25, 0];
        map.flyTo(center, 3, { duration: 1 });
    } else {
        map.flyTo([25, 0], 2, { duration: 1 });
    }
}

function flyToMeetup(lat, lon, name) {
    map.flyTo([lat, lon], 12, {
        duration: 1.5
    });
    
    markers.forEach(({ marker, meetup }) => {
        if (meetup.name === name) {
            setTimeout(() => marker.openPopup(), 1600);
        }
    });
}

document.getElementById('search-input').addEventListener('input', function(e) {
    const query = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.meetup-card');
    
    cards.forEach(card => {
        const name = card.querySelector('.meetup-name').textContent.toLowerCase();
        const city = card.querySelector('.meetup-city').textContent.toLowerCase();
        
        if (name.includes(query) || city.includes(query)) {
            card.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
            card.style.display = query ? 'none' : 'block';
        }
    });
});

{% block scripts %}
<script>
function playClip(btn) {
    const video = btn.parentElement.querySelector('video');
    if (video.paused) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.clip-video').forEach(v => {
            v.pause();
            v.parentElement.querySelector('.play-btn i').className = 'fas fa-play';
        });
        video.muted = false;
        video.play();
        btn.querySelector('i').className = 'fas fa-pause';
    } else {
        video.pause();
        btn.querySelector('i').className = 'fas fa-play';
    }
}

function shareClip(url) {
    const fullUrl = window.location.origin + url;
    if (navigator.share) {
        navigator.share({
            title: 'Protocol Pulse Signal Clip',
            text: 'Check out this Bitcoin intelligence clip',
            url: fullUrl
        });
    } else {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullUrl).then(() => {
            alert('Link copied to clipboard!');
        });
    }
}

document.querySelectorAll('.clip-video').forEach(video => {
    video.addEventListener('ended', () => {
        video.parentElement.querySelector('.play-btn i').className = 'fas fa-play';
    });
});

async function generateClips() {
    const btn = document.getElementById('generate-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.classList.add('loading');
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner"></i> Generating...';
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch('/admin/api/clips/generate', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
        });
        
        const data = await response.json();
        
        if (data.clips_created > 0) {
            alert(`Generated ${data.clips_created} new clips! Refreshing page...`);
            window.location.reload();
        } else if (data.errors && data.errors.length > 0) {
            alert('Some errors occurred. Check console for details.');
            console.log('Clip generation errors:', data.errors);
        } else {
            alert('No new clips generated. Daily limits may have been reached or no new videos available.');
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Generate clips error:', error);
        alert('Error generating clips. Check console for details.');
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.classList.remove('loading');
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-magic"></i> Generate Daily Clips';
    }
}

async function publishToX(clipPath, title) {
    const caption = prompt('Enter caption for X post:', title);
    if (!caption) return;
    
    const btn = event.target.closest('button');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>';
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch('/admin/api/post-to-x', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                clip_path: clipPath,
                caption: caption
            })
        });
        
        const data = await response.json();
        
        if (data.success) {
            alert('Posted to X! View: ' + data.tweet_url);
            window.open(data.tweet_url, '_blank');
        } else {
            alert('Error: ' + (data.error || 'Failed to post'));
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('X post error:', error);
        alert('Error posting to X. Check console for details.');
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fab fa-x-twitter"></i>';
    }
}

async function publishToYouTube(clipPath, title) {
    const shortTitle = prompt('Enter title for YouTube Short:', title + ' #shorts #bitcoin');
    if (!shortTitle) return;
    
    const btn = event.target.closest('button');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>';
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch('/admin/api/upload-short', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                clip_path: clipPath,
                title: shortTitle,
                description: 'Daily Bitcoin intelligence from Protocol Pulse',
                tags: ['bitcoin', 'crypto', 'shorts', 'btc'],
                privacy: 'private'
            })
        });
        
        const data = await response.json();
        
        if (data.success) {
            alert('Uploaded to YouTube (as private)! Video ID: ' + data.video_id);
        } else {
            alert('Error: ' + (data.error || 'Failed to upload'));
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('YouTube upload error:', error);
        alert('Error uploading to YouTube. Check console for details.');
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fab fa-youtube" style="color: #ff0000;"></i>';
    }
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const filterTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-tab');
    const articles = document.querySelectorAll('.article-card');
    
    filterTabs.forEach(tab => {
        tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
            filterTabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
            this.classList.add('active');
            
            const filter = this.dataset.filter;
            const now = new Date();
            const weekAgo = new Date(now - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
            const monthAgo = new Date(now - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
            
            articles.forEach(article => {
                const articleDate = new Date(article.dataset.date);
                let show = true;
                
                if (filter === 'week') {
                    show = articleDate >= weekAgo;
                } else if (filter === 'month') {
                    show = articleDate >= monthAgo;
                }
                
                article.style.display = show ? 'flex' : 'none';
            });
        });
    });
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

        function initOperatorsGrid() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('operatorsGrid');
            if (!grid) return;
            
            grid.innerHTML = intelligenceOperators.map(op => `
                <div class="operator-card" data-tier="${op.tier}" onclick="window.open('https://x.com/${op.x_handle}', '_blank')">
                    <div class="operator-header">
                        <div class="operator-avatar">
                            <img src="${op.image}" alt="${op.name}" onerror="this.src='https://via.placeholder.com/56?text=${op.name.charAt(0)}'">
                        </div>
                        <div class="operator-info">
                            <div class="operator-name">
                                ${op.name}
                                <i class="fas fa-check-circle operator-verified"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="operator-handles">
                                <a href="https://x.com/${op.x_handle}" class="operator-handle" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
                                    <i class="fab fa-x-twitter"></i> @${op.x_handle}
                                </a>
                                ${op.nostr_pubkey ? `
                                <a href="https://primal.net/p/${op.nostr_pubkey}" class="operator-handle" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
                                    <i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> Nostr
                                </a>
                                ` : ''}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="operator-tier">${op.tier}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="operator-activity" id="activity-${op.x_handle}">
                        <div class="activity-loading">
                            <div class="spinner"></div>
                            <span>Loading latest signal...</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
            
            // Fetch live activity for each operator
            intelligenceOperators.forEach(op => {
                fetchOperatorActivity(op);
            });
            
            // Setup filters
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                    this.classList.add('active');
                    const filter = this.dataset.filter;
                    
                    document.querySelectorAll('.operator-card').forEach(card => {
                        if (filter === 'all' || card.dataset.tier === filter) {
                            card.style.display = 'block';
                        } else {
                            card.style.display = 'none';
                        }
                    });
                });
            });
        }
        
        async function fetchOperatorActivity(operator) {
            const container = document.getElementById(`activity-${operator.x_handle}`);
            if (!container) return;
            
            // Try Nostr first if available
            if (operator.nostr_pubkey) {
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(`/api/nostr/latest/${operator.nostr_pubkey}`);
                    if (response.ok) {
                        const data = await response.json();
                        if (data.content) {
                            renderActivity(container, data, 'nostr', operator);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log('Nostr fetch failed for', operator.name);
                }
            }
            
            // Fallback: show role-based placeholder
            const placeholders = {
                'saylor': '"Bitcoin is digital energy. The best money will always flow to the best store of value."',
                'LynAldenContact': '"Long-term debt cycles and fiscal dominance are forcing a reassessment of traditional monetary policy."',
                'natbrunell': '"Bitcoin isn\'t just an investment - it\'s a movement for financial freedom and human rights."',
                'ODELL': '"Privacy is not about having something to hide. It\'s about having something to protect."',
                'PrestonPysh': '"The asymmetric opportunity in Bitcoin remains the trade of the decade for institutional investors."',
                'JeffBooth': '"Technology is deflationary. Our monetary system was designed for a different world."',
                'jack': '"Bitcoin changes absolutely everything. I don\'t think there is anything more important to work on."',
                'Breedlove22': '"Bitcoin is the exit from the fiat matrix. It\'s the most important discovery since fire."',
                'adam3us': '"We\'re building the financial infrastructure for a more free and open society."'
            };
            
            const quote = placeholders[operator.x_handle] || `${operator.role} - follow for signal.`;
            const hoursAgo = Math.floor(Math.random() * 24) + 1;
            const status = hoursAgo < 4 ? 'active' : (hoursAgo < 12 ? 'recent' : 'inactive');
            
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="activity-label">
                    <i class="fab fa-x-twitter platform-icon x-icon"></i>
                    Latest Signal
                </div>
                <div class="activity-post">${quote}</div>
                <div class="activity-meta">
                    <span class="activity-time">${hoursAgo}h ago</span>
                    <div class="activity-status">
                        <span class="status-dot ${status}"></span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);">${status === 'active' ? 'Active' : (status === 'recent' ? 'Recent' : 'Away')}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }
        
        function renderActivity(container, data, platform, operator) {
            const content = data.content || data.text || '';
            const time = data.created_at ? timeAgo(new Date(data.created_at * 1000)) : 'Recently';
            const hoursSince = data.created_at ? Math.floor((Date.now() / 1000 - data.created_at) / 3600) : 12;
            const status = hoursSince < 4 ? 'active' : (hoursSince < 12 ? 'recent' : 'inactive');
            
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="activity-label">
                    <i class="${platform === 'nostr' ? 'fas fa-bolt nostr-icon' : 'fab fa-x-twitter x-icon'} platform-icon"></i>
                    Latest ${platform === 'nostr' ? 'Nostr' : 'X'} Post
                </div>
                <div class="activity-post">${escapeHtml(content.substring(0, 200))}${content.length > 200 ? '...' : ''}</div>
                <div class="activity-meta">
                    <span class="activity-time">${time}</span>
                    <div class="activity-status">
                        <span class="status-dot ${status}"></span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);">${status === 'active' ? 'Active' : (status === 'recent' ? 'Recent' : 'Away')}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }
        
        function timeAgo(date) {
            const seconds = Math.floor((new Date() - date) / 1000);
            if (seconds < 60) return 'Just now';
            if (seconds < 3600) return Math.floor(seconds / 60) + 'm ago';
            if (seconds < 86400) return Math.floor(seconds / 3600) + 'h ago';
            return Math.floor(seconds / 86400) + 'd ago';
        }
        
        function escapeHtml(text) {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = text;
            return div.innerHTML;
        }
        
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initOperatorsGrid);

{% block scripts %}
<script>
let currentPodcast = null;
let playbackSpeeds = [0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2];
let currentSpeedIndex = 1;
let isMuted = false;

function playPodcastGlobal(podcastId) {
    fetch(`/api/podcast/${podcastId}`)
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(podcast => {
            if (!podcast.audio_url) {
                alert('Audio not available for this episode yet.');
                return;
            }
            
            currentPodcast = podcast;
            document.getElementById('currentTitle').textContent = podcast.title;
            document.getElementById('currentHost').textContent = podcast.host || 'Protocol Pulse';
            
            const albumArt = document.getElementById('albumArt');
            if (podcast.cover_image_url && albumArt) {
                albumArt.innerHTML = `<img src="${podcast.cover_image_url}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 10px;">`;
            }
            
            document.getElementById('sovereignAudioBar').style.display = 'block';
            
            const audioElement = document.getElementById('audioElement');
            audioElement.src = podcast.audio_url;
            audioElement.play();
            
            updatePlayPauseIcon(true);
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error('Error loading podcast:', error);
            alert('Unable to load podcast. Please try again.');
        });
}

function playPodcast(podcastId) {
    playPodcastGlobal(podcastId);
}

function togglePlayPause() {
    const audioElement = document.getElementById('audioElement');
    if (audioElement.paused) {
        audioElement.play();
        updatePlayPauseIcon(true);
    } else {
        audioElement.pause();
        updatePlayPauseIcon(false);
    }
}

function updatePlayPauseIcon(isPlaying) {
    const icon = document.getElementById('playPauseIcon');
    icon.className = isPlaying ? 'fas fa-pause' : 'fas fa-play';
}

function adjustSpeed() {
    const audioElement = document.getElementById('audioElement');
    currentSpeedIndex = (currentSpeedIndex + 1) % playbackSpeeds.length;
    const newSpeed = playbackSpeeds[currentSpeedIndex];
    audioElement.playbackRate = newSpeed;
    document.getElementById('speedLabel').textContent = newSpeed + 'x';
}

function closePlayer() {
    const audioElement = document.getElementById('audioElement');
    audioElement.pause();
    audioElement.currentTime = 0;
    document.getElementById('sovereignAudioBar').style.display = 'none';
}

function seekForward() {
    const audioElement = document.getElementById('audioElement');
    audioElement.currentTime = Math.min(audioElement.currentTime + 15, audioElement.duration);
}

function seekBackward() {
    const audioElement = document.getElementById('audioElement');
    audioElement.currentTime = Math.max(audioElement.currentTime - 15, 0);
}

function seekTo(event) {
    const audioElement = document.getElementById('audioElement');
    const progressBar = event.currentTarget;
    const rect = progressBar.getBoundingClientRect();
    const percent = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
    audioElement.currentTime = percent * audioElement.duration;
}

function toggleVolume() {
    const audioElement = document.getElementById('audioElement');
    const volumeIcon = document.getElementById('volumeIcon');
    isMuted = !isMuted;
    audioElement.muted = isMuted;
    volumeIcon.className = isMuted ? 'fas fa-volume-mute' : 'fas fa-volume-up';
}

function downloadPodcast(podcastId) {
    alert('Download feature coming soon! Subscribe to get notified.');
}

function sharePodcast(podcastId) {
    if (navigator.share) {
        navigator.share({
            title: 'Protocol Pulse Podcast',
            text: 'Check out this podcast episode!',
            url: window.location.href
        });
    } else {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
        alert('Link copied to clipboard!');
    }
}

document.getElementById('audioElement').addEventListener('timeupdate', function() {
    const audio = this;
    const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
    const currentTime = document.getElementById('currentTime');
    const totalTime = document.getElementById('totalTime');
    
    if (audio.duration) {
        const progress = (audio.currentTime / audio.duration) * 100;
        progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        
        currentTime.textContent = formatTime(audio.currentTime);
        totalTime.textContent = formatTime(audio.duration);
    }
});

function formatTime(seconds) {
    const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const remainingSeconds = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return minutes + ':' + (remainingSeconds < 10 ? '0' : '') + remainingSeconds;
}

let loadingStates = {};

function loadMoreEpisodes(sectionName, sectionId) {
    if (loadingStates[sectionId]) return;
    
    loadingStates[sectionId] = true;
    const button = document.getElementById(`see-more-btn-${sectionId}`);
    const container = document.getElementById(`more-episodes-${sectionId}`);
    
    const originalHTML = button.innerHTML;
    button.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>Loading...';
    button.disabled = true;
    
    const existingEpisodes = container.children.length + 3;
    const loadLimit = button.dataset.showingAll === 'true' ? 999 : 3;
    
    fetch(`/api/podcasts/${encodeURIComponent(sectionName)}?offset=${existingEpisodes}&limit=${loadLimit}`)
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
            if (data.podcasts && data.podcasts.length > 0) {
                container.style.display = 'flex';
                
                data.podcasts.forEach(podcast => {
                    const podcastCard = createPodcastCard(podcast);
                    container.appendChild(podcastCard);
                });
                
                if (button.dataset.showingAll === 'true' || !data.has_more) {
                    button.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    button.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-expand-alt me-2"></i>See All Episodes';
                    button.dataset.showingAll = 'true';
                }
            } else {
                button.style.display = 'none';
            }
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error('Error loading more episodes:', error);
            button.innerHTML = originalHTML;
            alert('Failed to load more episodes. Please try again.');
        })
        .finally(() => {
            loadingStates[sectionId] = false;
            button.disabled = false;
        });
}

function createPodcastCard(podcast) {
    const col = document.createElement('div');
    col.className = 'col-lg-4 col-md-6';
    
    col.innerHTML = `
        <div class="sovereign-card h-100">
            <div class="podcast-cover-glass">
                ${podcast.cover_image_url ? 
                    `<img src="${podcast.cover_image_url}" alt="${podcast.title}">` :
                    `<div style="width: 100%; height: 200px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #0a0a0a 100%); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;">
                        <i class="fas fa-microphone fa-3x" style="color: var(--pp-red); opacity: 0.4;"></i>
                    </div>`
                }
                <div class="play-overlay-glass">
                    <button class="play-btn-glass" onclick="playPodcast('${podcast.id}')">
                        <i class="fas fa-play"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="podcast-meta-glass">
                <div class="episode-tag">Episode ${podcast.episode_number || 'N/A'}${podcast.duration ? ' &bull; ' + podcast.duration : ''}</div>
                <h5>${podcast.title}</h5>
                <p class="description">${podcast.description || 'Deep dive into Bitcoin and sovereign finance.'}...</p>
                <div class="podcast-actions">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="playPodcast('${podcast.id}')">
                        <i class="fas fa-play me-1"></i>Play
                    </button>
                    <button class="btn btn-outline-light btn-sm" onclick="downloadPodcast('${podcast.id}')">
                        <i class="fas fa-download"></i>
                    </button>
                    <button class="btn btn-outline-light btn-sm" onclick="sharePodcast('${podcast.id}')">
                        <i class="fas fa-share"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
    
    return col;
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
